description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'WindowSurface' that demonstrates direct surface manipulation and drawing on a window surface using a separate drawing thread.

classes.name: WindowSurface
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating surface-based drawing with a dedicated thread, including lifecycle and surface callback management.

classes.name: MovingPoint
classes.description: Helper class representing a point with position and delta movement, used for animated graphics.

classes.name: DrawingThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread responsible for rendering graphics onto the window surface in a continuous loop.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, requests the surface, and starts the drawing thread.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops the drawing thread safely when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the drawing thread when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Signals the drawing thread to terminate when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Callback indicating a surface is available; passes the surface to the drawing thread.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback for surface size or format changes (not implemented).

methods.name: surfaceRedrawNeeded
methods.description: Callback indicating a surface redraw is needed (empty implementation).

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Callback indicating surface destruction; instructs the thread to stop and waits for termination.
